kindIntroSaved: You're registering {name}. Picked the wrong kind? Change it here; you can do this until you submit it.
kindIntroNew: Choose one. You can change it later while you register, until you submit it.
kindKiranaBody: Grocery, provisions, daily needs. Bill at your counter, keep your stock and khata, and get orders from nearby customers.
kindSalonBody: Haircuts, grooming, beauty. Customers nearby book a time with you or your barbers.
changeKeeps: Your shop's name, address, location pin, photos and video stay.
changeLicenceStaysKirana: Your trade licence stays and is checked again for a kirana.
changeLicenceStaysSalon: Your trade licence stays and is checked again for a salon.
changeRemovesCertificate: We'll remove your Shops and Establishments certificate: only a kirana adds one.
changeNextKirana: Next: whether you sell food (then your FSSAI licence), and the UPI ID your customers pay to at the counter.
changeNextSalon: Next you'll add the salon's services and opening hours. A UPI ID or food answer you gave stays saved, unused by a salon, in case you change back.
upiHint: The one your customers pay to: in your UPI app (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM) under your profile or QR.
upiHowPaid: At the counter the app shows a QR with the bill's amount; the customer scans it and pays straight to this ID. Money never passes through Clozest. Our field team checks it when they visit.
saveBackToReview: Save and go back to the review
reviewPin: Pin on the map (customers find you here)
reviewEditDetails: Edit details or move the pin
reviewAfterSubmit: After you submit, our field team calls and visits to check the shop. Meanwhile you can add your products and start billing at the counter.
submitWhatNext: After you submit, our field team calls you to fix a time and visits {name}. Nearby customers can order from you once it's approved.
submitFixFirst: Something to fix first? Tap Not yet. You can't change the kind of shop after submitting.
gapFoodQuestion: Say whether you sell any food items.
gapFssaiNeeded: Your FSSAI licence is needed: you sell food.
gapFssaiRejected: Your FSSAI certificate wasn’t accepted: add the right one.
gapFssaiExpired: Your FSSAI licence has expired: add the renewed one.
foodQuestion: Do you sell any food items?
foodQuestionHint: Packed or loose: rice, dal, atta, oil, spices, biscuits, snacks, drinks, milk or eggs. Yes needs your FSSAI licence (the ₹100 basic registration is enough for most kiranas).
foodNoFssaiNeeded: No FSSAI needed. Our field team checks the shop at the visit.
fssaiPickPhotoOrPdf: Pick a photo or a PDF of your FSSAI certificate.
fssaiIntro: The 14-digit number and a photo or PDF of your FSSAI registration or licence certificate. We check it automatically, usually within a minute.
fssaiUploadNumberFirst: Type the 14-digit number above first, then add the certificate
fssaiUploadFirst: Take a photo or choose a PDF of the certificate
fssaiAskPerson: Ask a person to check it
noFssaiRenewTitle: How do I renew my FSSAI licence?
noFssaiTitle: Don’t have an FSSAI licence yet?
noFssaiApplyBefore: Apply online on the government’s FoSCoS site:
noFssaiBasicAfter: (Form A), ₹100 a year, paid there. You get the 14-digit number and the certificate online, usually within a few days.
noFssaiCsc: The FoSCoS site is in English. A CSC / Jan Seva Kendra near you can apply for you.
noFssaiCertificate: The certificate is the registration PDF you get once it is approved, not the payment or application receipt. What you’ve already saved (your answers, photos and video) stays. Come back with the number and the certificate together to finish.
fssaiCheckingDefault: Checking your FSSAI certificate. This usually takes under a minute.
fssaiExpired: It expired on {date}. Upload the renewed licence.
fssaiRejectedDefault: Upload a clear photo or the PDF of your FSSAI certificate.
fssaiEarlierStillGood: Your earlier licence stays good until {date}.
fssaiReasonEarlierEnded: Your earlier licence ended on {date}: orders start again once the new one is verified.
fssaiReasonExpired: This licence expired on {date}. Add the renewed certificate.
fssaiReasonNumber: The number on the certificate ({printed}) isn't the one you typed ({typed}). Check the number.
fssaiReasonName: The name on the certificate ({name}) doesn't match your shop's name or your name. Add your own shop's certificate.
reasonNameMismatch: The name on it doesn’t match your shop’s name or the owner’s name. If your details are wrong, change them in More → Edit (shop details): the licence is checked again by itself.
reasonAddressMismatchLocked: The address on it doesn’t match your shop’s address. If your address is wrong, ask our field team to change it (More → Edit (shop details) → Request address change): once they do, the licence is checked again by itself.
reasonAddressMismatch: The address on it doesn’t match your shop’s address. If your address is wrong, change it in More → Edit (shop details): the licence is checked again by itself.
reasonDuplicate: This licence is already used by another shop. If it is yours, write to support and we’ll sort it out.
shopLicencePickPhotoOrPdf: Pick a photo or a PDF of your licence or certificate.
shopLicenceIntro: Whichever your shop has, from your municipality or the labour department. We check it automatically against your shop’s name and address, and customers see “Licensed” on your shop. No paper? Your shop works the same, with no badge.
shopLicenceCheckingShops: Checking your shops and establishments certificate. This usually takes under a minute; you can go on meanwhile.
shopLicenceCheckingTrade: Checking your trade licence. This usually takes under a minute; you can go on meanwhile.
shopLicenceCheckedUntil: Checked: customers see “Licensed” on your shop until {date}.
shopLicenceCheckedNoEnd: Checked: customers see “Licensed” on your shop (no end date on it).
shopLicenceExpired: It expired on {date}. Upload the renewed one.
shopLicenceUploadFirst: Take a photo or choose a PDF ({doc})
leaveDuringUpload: A paper is still uploading. Leave anyway? It may not be saved.
licencesPageNote: Every paper you add is checked automatically; your shop stays open meanwhile.
